headline: Western Front Bases Shift Amid Heavy Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the western arc has quickened its tempo. Stlican Shelf has surged to thirty‑three ownership changes in the past day, eight of them in the last two hours, while Weathered Expanse still leads with thirty‑seven flips and a fresh burst of six in the last six hours. Godcrofts has heated up, recording five flips in the past two hours and seventeen total, and Farranac Coast added four recent turns to reach nine for the day. Fishermans Row, though quieter in the last two hours, still shows twenty‑two daily flips, and Stonecradle logged three new changes, bringing its total to ten. Casualty streams reinforce the picture: Stonecradle, Weathered Expanse, Linn Mercy, Marban Hollow and Kings Cage all report accelerating loss rates for both sides, while Loch Mor and Deadlands are cooling. Enlistment rates are climbing sharply in Godcrofts, Stlican Shelf, Weathered Expanse and Farranac Coast, signalling fresh reinforcements. The deep Warden interior and the Colonial‑held south remain static with no base turnovers.
